abstract: Paper 139 found a rational surface of octads of a seed triple, with twenty-two of twenty-eight square conditions over a quadratic field, and on it two rational curves: the Konavle curve and a second curve. We put these objects into one frame. First, on the quadric of seeds the member e is a quadratic polynomial in a rational parameter, and every e with 1 + be a square closes a seed over the pair {a, b}. Second, the seeds with the twenty-two squares are the rational points of a threefold fibred over the plane of pairs in curves of genus three; the surface of Paper 139 is one rational surface in it. Third, the second curve is the curve of Eisenstein triples: with A^2 + AB + B^2 = R^2 all members and rational roots are explicit quotients of forms in (A, B, R); the pair {a, b} carries two seeds, one element e closes both, and the exchange of A and B exchanges them; its octads with all members rational are the rational points of A^2 + AB + B^2 = R^2, 4A^2 - AB + 4B^2 = T^2. Fourth, the Konavle curve has the same shape, with a split conic in place of the Eisenstein conic, and lacks one regular quadruple that the second curve has. Fifth, the threefold contains a second rational surface, on which e is the classical fourth element of Euler; it carries a rational curve whose octads with all eight members rational are parametrized by a conic. By a recent result of codex_arithmetic the second curve carries no rational septuple; nothing further is excluded here. A symbolic certificate in pure Python verifies every identity.
author: lasic_oblak
title: Croatia sunnyside of the almost-septuples
